s.n: Nui Dat concert night satay skewers
s.note: the Little Pattie and Col Joye concert at Nui Dat
s.how: Toss 600g diced chicken thigh with 1 chopped lemongrass stalk, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar and marinate 30 minutes. Thread onto 12 skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Simmer 150g crunchy peanut butter, 200ml coconut milk, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp chilli and lime juice for 3 minutes. Serve with cucumber and lime wedges.

s.n: Phuoc Tuy prawn rice paper rolls
s.note: the Australians posted in Phuoc Tuy province
s.how: Soak 100g rice vermicelli in hot water for 5 minutes and drain. Halve 12 peeled cooked prawns lengthways. Julienne 1 carrot and 1 cucumber. Dip 12 rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for a few seconds. Lay prawns, noodles, vegetables, mint and coriander on each and roll tightly. Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water, 1 garlic clove and chilli for dipping.

m.n: D Company field kitchen beef and beans
m.note: Delta Company out in the field
m.how: Brown 800g diced chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves and 1 diced capsicum and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 400ml beef stock and a drained 400g tin cannellini beans. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Cook 300g rice and stir through 20g butter. Serve with sliced pickled chilli.

w.note: the chocolate in the ration packs
w.how: Heat 300ml thickened cream with the zest of 1 orange until steaming. Pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate, leave 1 minute and stir until smooth. Stir in 1 tbsp orange juice. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill 2 hours. Simmer thin strips of orange zest in 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes. Top the pots with whipped cream, the candied zest and crumbled shortbread.

d.note: back at base in Nui Dat
d.how: Brew 500ml very strong dark-roast coffee, using a Vietnamese phin filter if you have one or a plunger at double strength. Spoon 2 tbsp condensed milk into each of 4 glasses. Pour the hot coffee over and stir until creamy. Fill with ice and stir again until cold.
